{{Quote|For an unintelligent machine, the I.D.A. seems to have a mind of its own.|Complete Guide to Star Tours|<ref name="Complete Guide">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>}}
The '''Inventory Droid Assistant (I.D.A.)'''<ref name="Complete Guide" /> was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|repair droid]] owned by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] company during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Despite being an unintelligent machine, it seemed to have a mind of its own and a definite aversion to heavy work. The I.D.A. was operated by the worker [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D7]], who used it to bring replacement parts from inventory to the Droidnostics Center of [[Tomorrowland Starport]], though it had a hard [[Time/Legends|time]] getting the stubborn repair droid to work.<ref name="Complete Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Short for Inventory Droid Assistant. A machine of no intelligence but with definite aversion to heavy work.|The I.D.A.'s profile in ''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''|<ref name="Complete Guide" />}}
The background for this droid comes from a "Spot the Droid" poster displayed at the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which was translated at the EndorExpress.net fan site, as well as the ''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]'' booklet.
